blocks.text:
Expand what’s possible with Galaxy Z Fold7, the foldable that’s designed to do so much more than before.The expanded 6.5" cover display is made to feel like a traditional smartphone, making it more convenient to handle daily tasks— from text replies to checking the weather— without needing to unfold. For even more possibilities, open up the impressive 8" screen to create, unwind, multitask and more.For the first time ever for a foldable, Z Fold7 boasts a 200MP camera with ProVisual Engine so you can take stunning photos with ease. Perfecting your pics feels just as effortless. Enjoy plenty of room on the expansive inner screen to make tiny adjustments, like zooming in to delete that stranger in the background with Photo Assist or ensuring everyone’s eyes are open in the group selfie with Best Face.Whether you’re at home or on the go, creating on the large screen of Z Fold7 is as comfortable as it gets. View up to three windows at once and edit your content on one side while streaming videos and scrolling social feeds on the other. While you multitask, the customized Snapdragon® 8 Elite processor for Galaxy keeps your experiences smooth from start to finish.¹ Results for illustrative purposes and may vary. Check responses for accuracy. Compatible with certain features and with certain accounts. Internet connection required. Available on select devices, languages, and countries. Only available to users 18 years and older. Gemini is a trademark of Google.
 ² Display measurements are diagonal, and actual viewable area is less due to rounded corners and camera hole punch.
 ³ Snapdragon is a product of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and/or its subsidiaries.

items.label: BIGGER, YET SLIMMER THAN EVER
items.value: Who would’ve guessed that wider could also be lighter? The design of Galaxy Z Fold7 is refined to feel like a traditional smartphone with its expanded cover display.

items.label: BEST CAMERA ON A FOLD YET
items.value: You asked for more – now you can have the most. Galaxy Z Fold7 now boasts an ultra-premium 200MP camera with Pro-Visual Engine so you can effortlessly take incredibly detailed pics.

items.label: SCREENSHARE FOR STREAMLINED ASSISTANCE
items.value: Intrigued by something you see? Go Live with Google Gemini, then screenshare or point your camera at it for additional info or assistance on the fly.¹

items.label: DO AND VIEW MORE, ALL AT ONCE
items.value: With an 8” screen that allows you to view up to three windows at once, Galaxy Z Fold7 is the ultimate device for seeing and doing more.²

items: ALL THE POWER AND SPEED YOU NEED Smoothly run your day with the power and speed of Galaxy Z Fold7. With its customized Snapdragon 8 Elite processor for Galaxy, you can stream your favorite shows, edit photos, scroll social feeds and more with ease.³

items.label: TIME-TESTED TOUGHNESS
items.value: With a new, advanced Armor Aluminum frame and a Corning Gorilla Glass Ceramic 2 display, Galaxy Z Fold7 is built to handle whatever your on-the-go lifestyle throws at it.⁴

items.label: STAY LOCKED IN WITHOUT BEING PLUGGED IN
items.value: Create, work and game to the max – the battery life of Galaxy Z Fold7 is able to keep up with your busiest days.⁵

items.label: BETTER TOGETHER TO BETTER YOUR HEALTH
items.value: Conveniently track your health on the go with Galaxy Watch8 Classic, and then get deeper insights on the expansive screen of Z Fold7.⁶

items.label: EXPAND THE WAYS YOU STAY AHEAD
items.value: With Galaxy Z Fold7, you get to decide how to stay ahead. See your daily briefings at a glance on the cover screen, or unfold your phone for an expansive view.

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: Android, NFC, Samsung, Universal Bluetooth, Wifi
